scraped.scraped_description: The Circuit is a multi-yearlong collaborative journalism project focused on investigating and revealing the inner workings of the Cook County Circuit Court system.

name: The Circuit
tagline: A data-driven collaborative journalism investigation into Cook County's court system using 3 million criminal cases
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 - Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: multi-partner collaborative — sustainability contingent on continued partner commitment

news_articles.headline: Meet the Cook County judge attorneys least want to appear before

academic_citations.title: Cramming More Components Onto Integrated Circuits

awards: 2020 Peter Lisagor Award — Best Data Journalism
2020 Peter Lisagor Award — Best Series (Non-deadline Reporting)
2020 Peter Lisagor Award — Best Investigative/Public Service Reporting
outcome_methodology: Observational analysis of judicial patterns and case outcomes; no experimental design
documented_limitations: data covers 2000-2018 only; post-2018 cases not included
failure_modes: dataset frozen at 2018; ongoing updates unclear
partner organisations may reduce involvement over time
governance_model: Multi-organisation collaborative: Better Government Association, Injustice Watch, Chicago Reporter, DataMade, University of Chicago Harris School
curation_criteria: Criminal case records from Cook County Circuit Court; inclusion based on case availability in public court records database
contributor_governance: Collaborative governance across partner organizations with editorial oversight from journalism partners
political_relevance_summary: The Circuit addresses civic technology. A data-driven collaborative journalism investigation into Cook County's court system using 3 million criminal cases.

movement_building_utility.notes: General tool/platform without direct movement-building function

generalizability_notes: Moderate generalizability — partially open source; core approach could be replicated but may require significant adaptation.
